title: Lighthouses of the world: every light on one glowing map
excerpt: Wikidata knows of 9,770 lighthouses. I mapped them all and switched them on. Most were built in the industrial century, the oldest still standing is Roman, and the brightest coast belongs to Sweden, partly because Sweden wrote its lights down.
seo_description: 9,770 lighthouses on one glowing map: where they are per km of coast, when they were built, the oldest still standing and the tallest.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Lighthouses of the world' in black and amber on pale paper, beside a dark night map of northern Europe where every lighthouse glows amber and the Swedish and Finnish coasts form bright lines. Text: every lighthouse in Wikidata, 9,770 of them; AD 100, Tower of Hercules, oldest still standing; 341 lights per 1,000 km of coast in Sweden.
